items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, that's what Johnny Wiggs says, and he heard Oliver in person.

ctx.x: I heard his records. Oh, yeah. Well, you know, Lonnie Johnson played guitar with Blind Willie Dunn, and some of them are reported to have... They have two guitars. Yeah. It's been reported that King Oliver played on one of the records. To me, it didn't sound like it. How about you? Did it sound like it to you?
Well, that's what Johnny Wiggs says, and he heard Oliver in person. He said he was just playing his old style that he played before he went to normal.

Oh. Mm-hmm. Well... Lonnie never makes records with Lonnie because he left here way before me. Did you ever see him? Did you ever run across him after he'd become better known in yourself? Did you? Did you ever get together together? Yeah, I never really did. Did you ever play with anybody? Did you ever play in the same group together? Well, I'm going to tell you what happened. I was with a big show named Bronze Manigans. Yeah. And we played in Cleveland, Ohio. And they hired him there to do specials with the…
